title: The window isomorphism for proper direct image
statement:
Use the standing setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: a field $k$ of characteristic $p_0>0$ with $p_0\ne\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$, and a $k$-morphism $p:X\to Y$. Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\ell$ be a prime, fix an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$ with the condensed coefficient rings of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring; sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. For $T=X,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and write $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)=D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ for the unbounded derived category of module sheaves. Let $\IndCons(T,\Lambda)$ be the full subcategory of filtered colimits of constructible $\Lambda_T$-module sheaves [sk-def-sfb-constructible], computed in $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$, and let $\Dic(T,\Lambda)$ be the full subcategory whose cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] lie in $\IndCons(T,\Lambda)$ in every degree. Let $p:X\to Y$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] with geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] of Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most an integer $d$, and use its total derived module pushforward $Rp_*$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. For $K\in\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ and $q\in\mathbf Z$, the canonical truncation maps [def-kun-truncations]
$$
K\leftarrow\tau_{\leq q}K\to\tau_{\geq q-2d-1}\tau_{\leq q}K
$$
induce isomorphisms in $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$
$$
\mathcal H^q(Rp_*K)\xleftarrow{\sim}\mathcal H^q(Rp_*\tau_{\leq q}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H^q(Rp_*\tau_{\geq q-2d-1}\tau_{\leq q}K).
$$

proof.text: The existing pro-etale module-object framework supplies the abelian, Grothendieck and derived-category instances for the actual coefficient rings. [lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective] supplies K-injective resolutions. The additive module pushforward [def-sfb-module-lower-star] has the total right derived functor [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], which preserves distinguished triangles by [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated]. No separate ringed-site universe theorem or equivalence is needed in this application.

proof.text: Put $A=\tau_{\leq q}K$ and $B=\tau_{\geq q+1}K$. By [det-ambient-ind-derived-sums](truncation clause) and the canonical formulas of [def-kun-truncations], their cohomology sheaves are those of $K$ in the retained ranges and zero otherwise. Thus $A,B\in\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ and $B$ has no cohomology below $q+1$. The canonical distinguished triangle at $b=q+1$ in [lem-sf-derived-truncation-triangle] is $A\to K\to B\to A[1]$. By step 1 its image under $Rp_*$ is distinguished. The lower amplitude bound of [det-proper-unbounded-window-arbitrary] gives $H^{q-1}(Rp_*B)=H^q(Rp_*B)=0$. The exact sequence of [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] consequently contains $0\to H^q(Rp_*A)\to H^q(Rp_*K)\to0$. Exactness makes the displayed middle map both monic and epic, hence an isomorphism in the abelian module category. This is the map induced by $A\to K$, not merely an abstract isomorphism.

source.place: First map; canonical triangle: Stacks Tag 08J5 (remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle); cohomology exactness: Tag 05RS (lemma-cohomology-homological)

proof.text: Put $r=q-2d-2$, $L=\tau_{\leq r}A$, and $W=\tau_{\geq r+1}A$, with $A$ as in step 2. [det-ambient-ind-derived-sums](truncation clause) and [def-kun-truncations] give $L,W\in\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ and $L\in\Dic^{\leq r}(X,\Lambda)$. Apply [lem-sf-derived-truncation-triangle] to $A$ at $b=r+1$ to obtain $L\to A\to W\to L[1]$, and then apply step 1. The upper amplitude bound in [det-proper-unbounded-window-arbitrary] gives $Rp_*L\in\Dic^{\leq r+2d+1}=\Dic^{\leq q-1}(Y,\Lambda)$. Thus $H^q(Rp_*L)=H^{q+1}(Rp_*L)=0$. The exact sequence of [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] now contains $0\to H^q(Rp_*A)\to H^q(Rp_*W)\to0$, so the map induced by $A\to W$ is an isomorphism. Here $W=\tau_{\geq q-2d-1}\tau_{\leq q}K$ by substitution, exactly the stated second map. Finally [det-proper-unbounded-window-arbitrary] puts the direct images of $K,A,W$ in $\Dic(Y,\Lambda)$, so all three degree-$q$ sheaves belong to $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$. This is a full subcategory, so the ambient inverse maps also belong to it. Together with step 2 this proves both asserted isomorphisms in that category.

source.place: Second map; use the canonical triangle of A directly (Tag 08J5), the same amplitude bound, and the cohomology sequence (Tag 05RS)

lean.statement:
theorem proper_unbounded_window_iso
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p₀ : ℕ) [CharP k p₀] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hpℓ : p₀ ≠ ℓ)
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] (d : ℤ)
    (hd : ∀ (y : Y) (n : ℕ),
      (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim
        ↥(pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) (AlgebraicClosure (Y.residueField y)))) ≫
            Y.fromSpecResidueField y)) → (n : ℤ) ≤ d)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj K)) (q : ℤ) :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Y)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K)) ∧
    ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Y)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE q).obj K))) ∧
    ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Y)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (q - 2 * d - 1)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE q).obj K)))) ∧
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map
      ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLEι q).app K))) ∧
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map
      ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ (q - 2 * d - 1)).app
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLE q).obj K))))
